subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat message actions ship as a scoped Copy/Select Copy MVP, the full Copy/Select Copy/Share/Reply sheet, or no core Android change for now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the issue proposes multiple user-visible actions and there is an open conflicting fork PR, so automation should not choose the permanent Android interaction scope.

options.title: Scoped Copy/Select MVP
options.body: Add long-press Copy and Select Copy first, preserving scroll and link behavior, and leave Share/Reply for follow-up product approval.

options.title: Full Four-Action Sheet
options.body: Adopt the broader Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply design after deciding how reply context is represented in the composer and outgoing message.

options.title: Decline Core Android Change
options.body: Keep current Android chat rendering and close the linked implementation attempts if maintainers decide this interaction is not worth the native UI surface.

recommendation.title: Scoped Copy/Select MVP
recommendation.body: Add long-press Copy and Select Copy first, preserving scroll and link behavior, and leave Share/Reply for follow-up product approval.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Android chat-adjacent commit/committer history and prior review routing point to steipete as the best available owner for the product-scope choice.
